title: 第7章 沉浸式开荒初体验第8章 凡兽与道体
lines: 三人相互对视了一眼，都从对方眼中看到了难以抑制的兴奋。
姜望描绘的蓝图固然令人心潮澎湃。
但同时。
他们也不是什么刚接触游戏的新人小白。
脑子还是在转的。
官网背景资料里写得明明白白，这位姜望可是上仙域补天圣地的核心弟子，正儿八经的仙人，虽然现在修为尽失。
但主角光环肯定是顶配的。
按照游戏常识，只要版本不抛弃他。
紧跟这种背景深厚的天命主角走，绝对是收益最高的选择。
“弟子剑斩红尘，拜见门主！”
“弟子琉璃仙梦，拜见门主！”
“弟子莽穿地球，拜见门主！”
三人交换了个眼神，几乎是异口同声，还躬身行起了礼，就是动作显得有些生涩滑稽。
姜望负手而立，微微颔首，算是接受了他们的拜见。
“既入我门，当守门规。”
他面色平静，目光缓缓扫过三人。
“需勤修不辍，守望相助，不得同门相残，不得背叛仙门……具体细则，待仙门稍具规模，自会颁布。”
然而，姜望心知肚明。
寻常的道德约束或门派戒律，对于这些玩家来说，效果恐怕有限。
他们不死不灭，无利不起早，行事逻辑全凭本心。
姜望略一沉吟，决定祭出“大杀器”
于是，目光陡然变得锐利起来，仿佛能穿透三人的灵魂：
“若有人胆敢触犯门规，或阳奉阴违，本座将以界灵引之力，将尔等神魂永久驱逐出此界，永世不得再入！”
永久驱逐？
这不就是封号吗？
三人心中同时一凛。
原本那点‘玩游戏可以随便浪’的小心思瞬间收拢。
他们这才猛地意识到，眼前这个姜望，恐怕不仅仅是剧情NPC那么简单。
能把他们召唤过来，还能威胁驱逐。
这分明是带有GM（游戏管理员）权限啊！
剑斩红尘心思最活络，立刻联想到另一个关键问题，他小心翼翼地开口：
“门主，那个，我们该如何退出游……此界？返回我们原本的世界呢？”
姜望看了他一眼，语气平淡地解答：
“神识凝聚，意念呼唤“退出”
即可，反之，欲要归来，亦通过‘修仙令’感应此界坐标，凝聚意识进入，但无论是这边还是那头，最好都先给躯体找一个安全，不易被打扰的地方！”
content_en:
The three of them looked at each other and saw uncontrollable excitement in each other's eyes.
The blueprint drawn by Jiang Wang is certainly exciting.
But at the same time.
They are not newbies who are new to the game.
My mind is still spinning.
The background information on the official website clearly states that this Jiang Wang is a core disciple of the Heaven-Mending Holy Land in the Upper Immortal Realm, a serious immortal, although his cultivation has now been completely lost.
But the protagonist’s halo is definitely top-notch.
According to game common sense, as long as the version does not abandon him.
Following this fateful protagonist with a profound background is definitely the most profitable choice.
"Disciple cuts the world with his sword and pays homage to the sect master!"
"Disciple Liuli Xianmeng, pay your respects to the sect master!"
"Disciple travels across the earth to meet the sect master!"
The three of them exchanged glances, almost speaking in unison, and even bowed and saluted, but their movements seemed a bit jerky and funny.
Jiang Wang stood with his hands behind his back and nodded slightly, accepting their visit.
"Once you enter my door, you must abide by the rules."
His face was calm, and his eyes slowly swept over the three people.
"You need to cultivate diligently, watch and help each other, and are not allowed to kill each other, or betray the Immortal Sect... The specific details will be promulgated when the Immortal Sect has a slightly larger scale."
However, Jiang Wang knew it well.
Ordinary moral constraints or sect precepts may have limited effect on these players.
They are immortal, do not start early without profit, and act logically based on their own hearts.
Jiang Wang thought for a moment and decided to use the "big killer weapon"
Then, his gaze suddenly became sharp, as if it could penetrate the souls of the three people:
"If anyone dares to violate the rules of the sect, or violates the rules of the sect, I will use the power of the world spirit to permanently expel your soul from this world, and you will never be able to enter again!"
Permanent eviction?
Isn't this just a ban?
The three of them were shocked at the same time.
The original thought of "you can play games as much as you want" suddenly disappeared.
Only then did they suddenly realize that the Jiang Wang in front of them was probably more than just a plot NPC.
He can summon them over and threaten to expel them.
This clearly has GM (Game Manager) authority!
Jian Zhan Hongchen was the quickest thinker and immediately thought of another key issue. He spoke cautiously:
"Master, um, how do we exit this world? Return to our original world?"
Jiang Wang glanced at him and answered calmly:
"The consciousness is condensed, and the mind calls for "exit"
That's it. On the contrary, if you want to return, you can also sense the coordinates of this world through the 'Cultivation Order' and gather your consciousness to enter. But whether it is here or there, it is best to find a safe place for your body that is not easily disturbed! "
